io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.player

Class PlayerBackpack

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.player.PlayerBackpack

  • public class PlayerBackpack
extends java.lang.Object
    This class represents the instance of a SlimefunBackpack that is ready to be opened. It holds an actual Inventory and represents the backpack on the level of an individual ItemStack as opposed to the class SlimefunBackpack.
    See Also:
    SlimefunBackpack, BackpackListener

        public static void writeIdentity(@Nonnull
                                 org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack item,
                                 @Nonnull
                                 java.lang.String identity)
        Stores the given "#" identity in the item's persistent data and removes any visible legacy ID lore line, so the identity is hidden from the tooltip going forward.

      • ensureIdentity

        public static void ensureIdentity(@Nonnull
                                  org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack item,
                                  @Nonnull
                                  java.util.UUID owner,
                                  @Nonnull
                                  java.util.function.IntSupplier newIdSupplier)
        Ensures the backpack item carries a persistent identity: migrates a legacy lore id to persistent data, or - if it has none at all - assigns a fresh one from newIdSupplier (only invoked in that case, since creating a backpack has a side effect). No-op if it already has a stored identity.
